reader_question: How many people work for civic and social organizations, and how has that changed?
grade_line: Documented: a Census Bureau count of employers
title: Civic and social organizations employed 201,423 people in March 2023, about 113,300 fewer than in 1998.
reading_guide: Each point is one year’s count of paid employees, taken in the pay period that includes March 12.
measure_line: Paid employees of civic and social organizations, such as service clubs and neighborhood associations, each year from 1998, the first year counted under today’s industry codes, to 2023, United States
notes: Groups run only by volunteers have no paid employees and do not appear in the count.
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, civic and social organizations (NAICS 813410), 1998 to 2023, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Establishments with paid employees only; employees counted in mid-March.
alt: A line of paid employees at civic and social organizations from 1998 to 2023: 314,723 in 1998, about 330,000 in 2007, 246,979 in 2009 and 201,423 in 2023.
